story.title: Continual Evolution and Dedication to Improving Human Well-being
story.description: From a simple idea — everyone deserves a personal doctor — HealthOS has grown into Vietnam's leading digital health platform.
story.card1Desc: Democratize healthcare through AI, giving everyone access to accurate and timely medical information.
story.card2Desc: Data privacy, algorithmic transparency, and always putting users' health interests first.
story.card3Desc: AI meal photo analysis, biometric anomaly detection algorithms, and real-time wearable data synchronization.
